description: Search available marketplace product listings in Uganda so users can compare options. Supply complete alternate item phrases in synonyms (e.g. wedding dress and bridal gown for wedding gown). Relevant listings are ranked and capped; price bounds are in UGX. Results include original marketplace links; confirm current availability, condition and seller details there. Explicit price sorts return a single unscored page. For businesses or service providers instead, use search_businesses.

min_relevance_score.description: Minimum complete-phrase score; two-word phrases score at least 2

query.description: Item to search for, e.g. wedding gown

region.description: Marketplace region slug, if known; omit rather than guessing a district-to-slug mapping

sort.description: rel/new: newest-first with phrase ranking; price sorts: one unscored page

source.description: Optional marketplace source identifier if supported; omit to use the default source

synonyms.description: Complete alternative item phrases, e.g. ['wedding dress', 'bridal gown']

name: search_marketplace
